info.title: CuteDB HTTP server
info.description: A single-file HTTP server around a CuteDB database, so the Python, Go and Node.js clients — or anything that speaks JSON over HTTP — can use it. Optional API key, CORS, and an OpenAPI description at /openapi.json.

x-inspectra.cliParsedTitle: cutedb-server — an HTTP API over one CuteDB database.
x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Gravicode Studios, led by Kang Fadhil.

options.name: --api-key
options.description:
Require this key as X-API-Key or a bearer token.
Also read from the CUTEDB_API_KEY environment variable.

options.name: --cors
options.description: Comma-separated origins allowed from a browser.
